from: chapitres 1 et 2 de la vidéo longue (le dollar Netflix du T3 2026 découpé, puis le coût fixe d'une série ; coupé : régions, publicité, marge historique)
paragraphs: Out of every dollar Netflix earns, where does the money go? We took apart its latest quarter.
Almost {thirty-three cents|33¢} pays for content: the shows and films, spread over time.
About {fourteen cents|14¢} runs the service: streaming, payment fees and other costs.
Then {eight cents|8¢} for technology, {six and a half|6.5¢} for marketing, and {three and a half|3.6¢} for general costs.
What's left? {Thirty-four point six cents|34.6¢} of operating profit. A third of every dollar.
The secret: a show costs the same whether one person watches it or three hundred million. Full story on the channel.
